contemporaneous_photos_read.evidence: Nursery exterior cladding damage, north gallery condition and exposed cladding support.
Foundation/interior cracking, damaged ceiling, exterior pipes, roof/eaves and gallery column damage; no stated main roof mass collapse.

damage_assessment.known: Cracked foundation/plaster, damaged fishscale cladding, insect-damaged gallery posts/struts, collapsed interior timber ceiling, roof timber/tile damage and drainage damage.
damage_assessment.why_not_same_as_caoshan_hold: The collapse explicitly described is the interior ceiling; inspected text and drawings do not identify a missing/collapsed principal roof volume needing invented reconstruction. Complete current roof diagram and four elevations mutually document its envelope.
damage_assessment.limits: This is evidence for surveyed architectural envelope, not evidence that roof members/tiles or the building were intact. Fine decay/spalling/crack geometry can be excluded only with explicit disclosure; do not claim damage-exact as-is replica or restored condition.

change_control.pdf123: Figure4-7-12 is current damage plan with repair instructions overlaid. Larger hatching marked加建拆除 and雨遮拆除 lies outside main body with drawn intervening gaps. It is not authorization to replace current main-body geometry with a restoration design.
